description: This file defines Express routes related to user operations such as registration, login, profile management, appointment booking, and payment processing. It imports controller functions and middleware to handle request routing.

methods.name: POST /register
methods.description: Handles user registration by invoking the registerUser controller.

methods.name: POST /login
methods.description: Handles user login by invoking the loginUser controller.

methods.name: GET /get-profile
methods.description: Retrieves the user's profile after authentication.

methods.name: POST /update-profile
methods.description: Updates user profile including image upload, with authentication.

methods.name: POST /book-appointment
methods.description: Books an appointment for the authenticated user.

methods.name: GET /appointments
methods.description: Lists all appointments for the authenticated user.

methods.name: POST /payment-razorpay
methods.description: Processes Razorpay payment for the user.

methods.name: POST /payment-stripe
methods.description: Processes Stripe payment for the user.
